name: isaac-feeding
description: Isaac's Feeding Tracker — local-first feeding and pumping log

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @isaac/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @isaac/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @isaac/api dev" "pnpm --filter @isaac/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @isaac/shared build && pnpm --filter @isaac/api build && pnpm --filter @isaac/web build
scripts.dev:demo: pnpm --filter @isaac/shared build && node scripts/generate-demo-data.mjs && DATA_FILE="$PWD/data/demo/feeding.json" pnpm dev
